svg.aria-label: claude-blog hero: in Claude Code you type /blog write with a topic, the bots search the web, tag tier 1 to 3 sources and throw a clickbait page in the trash, and a blog post writes itself line by line. The blog-reviewer scores it 87 with one P0 for an unsourced statistic, the green bot slaps on a source as citation [1], the score climbs to 94, all five delivery gates open and the post is delivered, ready for Google and AI answers.
